title: Safe routes to school software and walk audit
summary: The Maui MPO expects safe routes to school software to be delivered by the end of October and presented in November. Staff will also co-organize a walk audit with the Department of Health later this year or early next year.

timeline.text: Staff will co-organize a walk audit with the Department of Health later this year or early next year.
